detail.title: 自适应张力抓手
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses a self-adaptation tension tongs, it relates to and snatchs the component. Including installing support, sucking disc interface, tension bag interface, tension utricule, tension bag mount pad and vacuum chuck, be provided with the sucking disc interface on the installing support, sucking disc interface below is connected with the tension bag mount pad, and tension bag mount pad side is provided with the tension bag interface, installs the tension utricule on the tension bag mount pad, and tension utricule center is provided with vacuum chuck, and vacuum chuck passes tension bag mount pad and sucking disc interface intercommunication. The utility model provides a to the problem of snatching of small-size surface irregular work piece, very big improvement production efficiency, eliminated the potential safety hazard.
